Question: What's revenue?
Description: Revenue (MTD/YTD). Also known as: Azure consumption revenue. No default product filter. Use product_mid_group to filter by 'Fabric' or 'Power BI'. azure_closed_month_flag defaults to TRUE (applied at the measure level — overridable via the filters argument).

Question: What's revenue by Power BI and Fabric SKU?
Description: Two-row P-vs-F SKU comparison for one AccountKey: 'Power BI Premium' (P SKU) vs 'Fabric' Product (F SKU). Use ONLY when the user explicitly wants the P-vs-F split. For all-up Fabric revenue (rolled up across Power BI Premium + Fabric + other Fabric-billed products), use the generic 'revenue' question with filter 'Product Master'[Product Mid Group]=Fabric.
HardcodedFilters: 'Product Master'[Product]=Power BI Premium;Fabric|'Calendar'[Azure Closed Month Flag]=True
